exposure: discontinuation of disease-modifying therapies (DMT) for planned pregnancy
cohort: The cohort consisted of 27 women with relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis (RRMS) who discontinued disease-modifying therapies to attempt conception.
finding: Discontinuation of disease-modifying therapies (DMT) for planned pregnancy in women with RRMS resulted in increased MS relapse rates and disability progression.
